message: CLIRUN-1-1 needs the pinned structured invocation contract: MCP tool name, argv count/per-arg/total size limits, whether each template '*' matches exactly one arg or a trailing remainder, and whether invocation identity verifies both executableHash and executableVersion (including the version probe argv). The brief requires these observable rejections/checks but does not specify them; choosing would invent a public/security contract.

notes: Pinned contract: (1) MCP tool name 'capability_run' (host prefixes into the gantry MCP namespace as with other gantry tools). (2) argv limits: max 64 entries, max 4096 bytes/entry, max 16384 bytes total; reject any entry containing a NUL byte. (3) Template '*' semantics: DO NOT reinvent — validate by constructing the argv into a BashCommandLeaf and reusing the existing bashScopeMatchesLeaf(templateScope, leaf) matcher, so trailing-remainder and prefix semantics are inherited EXACTLY from the shell path; the structured tool authorizes exactly what the projected rule did, minus the shell. (4) Executable identity: verify executableHash at invocation (hash the file at executablePath, compare) to close TOCTOU; if executableHash is absent, fail closed. executableVersion probe is DEFERRED (running the exe is the gated action; the content hash is the strong invariant).

message: CLIRUN-1-1 cannot satisfy both no-shell argv execution and reuse of the existing sandboxed executor within scope: jobs/async-command-sandbox-runner.ts is the sandboxed bounded executor but only accepts a command string via /bin/sh -c, while adapters/sandbox/approved-command-runner.ts accepts argv but is a direct host spawn; both are outside the declared write scope. Expand scope to one executor contract or clarify which executor is binding.

notes: Binding executor = jobs/async-command-sandbox-runner.ts (runSandboxedAsyncCommand): it owns the sandbox + bounding + timeout + cancellation we must reuse. Extend it to accept a structured argv form { executable, args[] } that launches WITHOUT /bin/sh -c (exec the executable with args passed safely as argv, never interpolated into a shell string), preserving all the existing sandbox/bounding/timeout/cancellation machinery. Keep the existing string path for legacy RunCommand until CLIRUN-1-3 cutover. Do NOT use adapters/sandbox/approved-command-runner.ts as the executor (bare host spawn, unsandboxed) - that fails the reuse-the-sandboxed-executor requirement. write_scope widened to include apps/core/src/jobs and apps/core/src/adapters/sandbox.
